incidents.name: LAURAToken
incidents.notes: Unprotected removeLiquidityWhenKIncreases() in the LAURA token removes LAURA from the pair, letting attacker steal the pair's WETH.

sources.ref: Recheck of the deployment basis (DELEGATECALL audit): the victim is an EIP-1167 minimal-proxy clone whose 45-byte runtime hardcodes the master 0x539d54074e052ae82de4936ae6bb213ab773559e, so the DELEGATECALL target cannot be repointed; the master's runtime is byte-identical at the clone's creation block 21516710 and the incident block 21529888 and contains no DELEGATECALL, so deployment is exact.
